description: 与奥丁、维共同参与创世的兄弟神之一。
fullDescription: 关于威利的独立外观资料极少。本卡不能把现代常见的‘意志之神’解释当作来源事实，而应围绕他作为创世三兄弟成员的叙事功能建立视觉差异。
roleInSeries: 让创世行为明确是三兄弟共同完成，而非奥丁单人神话。

sourceRefs.note: 威利与奥丁、维共同杀死尤弥尔并塑造世界。

visualThesis: 动作感最强的三兄弟成员：正常神祇尺度、清晰独立脸型，以推动/抬起/组织原初材料的身体动作体现参与创世。

sourceBoundFacts: 与奥丁、维共同参与创世
来源没有提供稳定的独立外貌属性
interpretationNotes: ‘意志、力量’等人格化解释只能作为艺术方向，不作为硬神话事实
发色、年龄、服装均属设计
canon.worldState: 世界正在形成；不得出现成熟神域、王权或后世神器。
identityAnchors: 独立于奥丁和维的脸型
mustKeep: 更动态、更向前的身体姿态
服装与奥丁同文明但不复制

instructions: 与奥丁：不独眼、不使用王者符号、脸型与发型不同
与维：姿态更动态，构图斜线更强；维保持稳定秩序感

visual.detailHierarchy: 脸、手、主要动作最高细节；身体中等；背景低细节。
visual.subjectSeparation: 利用动作方向和局部光线从材料背景中分离。

prompt.draft: Create Vili as a distinct normal-scale creator god participating in the making of the world, not as an Odin clone. Give him a different face, hairstyle and silhouette from Odin and Vé. Use an energetic forward-moving pose handling raw stone, sea or world-material in a symbolic but grounded way. No one-eye trait, throne, spear, ravens, crown or generic Viking battle gear. Keep the environment unfinished and simple. Subject-first painterly illustration, restrained Nordic material language, crop-safe upper-body identity.
prompt.final:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Asset type: MythCanvas Norse M01 collectible-card source artwork.

Create ONE standalone portrait 9:16 pure artwork for card 1003010005, Vili / 威利, type character.

This is an original mythological interpretation, not a copy of a modern franchise design.

The image must contain no typography, title, logo, card frame, number, watermark, pseudo-runes, UI, collage, split layout, contact sheet, or panels.

Content brief: Create Vili as a distinct normal-scale creator god participating in the making of the world, not as an Odin clone. Give him a different face, hairstyle and silhouette from Odin and Vé. Use an energetic forward-moving pose handling raw stone, sea or world-material in a symbolic but grounded way. No one-eye trait, throne, spear, ravens, crown or generic Viking battle gear. Keep the environment unfinished and simple. Subject-first painterly illustration, restrained Nordic material language, crop-safe upper-body identity.

Visual thesis: 动作感最强的三兄弟成员：正常神祇尺度、清晰独立脸型，以推动/抬起/组织原初材料的身体动作体现参与创世。

Identity anchors: 独立于奥丁和维的脸型；主动造物动作；正常神祇尺度

Must keep: 更动态、更向前的身体姿态；服装与奥丁同文明但不复制；无后世神器

Must avoid: 奥丁换脸；维换脸；独眼；王座；重甲英雄；维京战士模板

Composition: camera low angle; shot dynamic three-quarter; keep the primary subject/action inside the crop-safe upper-middle area.

Match the established M01 artwork family: painterly mythic realism with matte surfaces, broad readable shapes, controlled cinematic blue-white frost and restrained ember light, atmospheric depth, limited focal sharpness, and restrained brush detail. Subject or key moment must be sharper and more contrasted than the background. Use mythology-first visual storytelling rather than generic AI fantasy. Keep at most one primary environmental motif and one secondary motif; preserve quiet areas and clear visual hierarchy. Compose for future card crop safety: the face, hands, identity symbol, key object, or story action must work in the upper-middle area; the bottom 30 percent may be sacrificed.

Color and material guidance: palette 石灰；冷海蓝；褐灰; materials 粗织物；石粉；湿岩; mood active；constructive；restrained.

Related card IDs for narrative continuity only: 1003010004；1003010006. Preserve their mythic relationship without cloning faces, silhouettes, or poses.

Avoid these failure modes: Odin clone；Vé clone；one eye；throne；spear；ravens；crown；Viking warrior armor；giant scale；typography；glossy game-CG; excessive particles, floating debris overload, glossy game-CG, hyper-detailed-everything, random glowing runes, generic Viking cosplay, modern copyrighted adaptation, malformed anatomy, extra limbs, unreadable hands or props.

Fill one complete portrait 9:16 canvas with no margins. Target final canvas at least 1620x2880 pixels.
